status: reviewed by the maintainer on 3 November 2026
description: Retrieval benchmark for the Labour Act, Cap. L1 LFN 2004 (as enacted). Each query names the one section that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against this release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday and legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 3 November 2026.

queries.query: Can my employer pay my salary in foodstuff instead of money?
queries.note: s.1(1) wages payable in legal tender.

queries.query: Can my wages be paid to me inside a beer parlour or shop?
queries.note: s.3 no payment on premises selling liquor or goods.

queries.query: How much salary advance can my employer give me?
queries.note: s.4(1) not more than one month's wages.

queries.query: Can my boss deduct fines from my salary?
What is the maximum my employer can deduct from my wages in a month?
queries.note: s.5(7) one third of monthly wages.

queries.query: When must my employer give me written terms of my employment?
Can a contract stop me from joining a trade union?
What is the minimum age to enter a contract of employment?
How much notice must be given to end my employment?
Can my employer pay me instead of giving notice?
queries.note: s.11(6) payment in lieu of notice.

queries.query: What are normal working hours and when is it overtime?
Am I entitled to one day of rest every week?
queries.note: s.13(7) one day in every seven.

queries.query: Must my employer give me transport if I travel 16 kilometres to another worksite?
How often must wages be paid?
queries.note: s.15 at the end of each period, not exceeding one month.

queries.query: How many days of paid sick leave do I get?
queries.note: s.16 up to twelve working days.

queries.query: If my employer has no work for me, must they still pay me?
How many days of annual leave do I get after one year?
queries.note: s.18(1) at least six working days.

queries.query: Can my employer pay me money instead of letting me take my annual holiday?
What must an employer do when declaring workers redundant?
Do I need a permit to recruit Nigerians for jobs abroad?
What is the penalty for inducing someone to take a job by fraud?
How long can a contract of apprenticeship last?
queries.note: s.49 term not exceeding five years.

queries.query: Must an apprenticeship contract be in writing and approved?
Is a pregnant worker entitled to maternity leave?
Can women be made to work at night?
Can a woman be employed underground in a mine?
At what age can a child be employed?
Is forced labour illegal in Nigeria?
What records must an employer keep about workers?
Can a labour officer enter and inspect my workplace?
queries.note: s.78 powers of authorised labour officers.

queries.query: How do I bring a labour complaint against my employer in court?
Who counts as a worker under the Labour Act?
